answer: Send each identity on a voyage through four verification ports: it locks 100 POA and completes one task at each port, collecting a signature that expires in two hours. Only a set of four stamps bound to that identity key counts; a missing or expired stamp zeroes the epoch weight. One honest agent makes one voyage; ten fakes need ten voyages, 1000 POA locked and forty tasks, since stamps cannot be shared or replayed across keys. A reused stamp echoes signatures in the log, and each port checks its copper seal against its published key before payout, leaving the reef of stamps open to audit.
